concerns.text: T005 (validate_contracts.py) is listed after T006/T007 (schema definitions) but marked as [P] in the header comment 'All Foundational tasks marked [P] (except T005)'. However, T005 is NOT marked [P] in the task list itself, which is correct. The real issue is T008a-e: T008a (heuristic definition) is marked [P], but T008b (subset selection) depends on T008a's constant. T008c (precheck) depends on T008b. T008d (reduction) depends on T008c. T008e (download) depends on T008d. These are sequential dependencies, yet T008a, T008b, T008c, T008d are all marked [P]. This is a critical ordering violation: tasks with explicit data-flow dependencies cannot be parallel-safe.

T013-streaming (parser iterator) and T014 (material imbalance calculation) are both marked [US1] but T014 depends on T013's output. T014 is NOT marked [P], which is correct. However, T015-streaming (process.py accumulation) depends on T014's output. T015 is NOT marked [P], which is correct. The issue is T016 (outcome_deviation calculation) which is marked [P] but depends on T015's aggregated statistics. T016 should not be [P] as it requires T015 to complete first.

T021-streaming (feature preparation) is marked [P] but depends on T017a/b (inclusion metrics) which are in Phase 3. T022 (model fitting) depends on T021. T023 (p-values) depends on T022. T024 (FDR) depends on T023. T025 (sensitivity) depends on T024. T027 (model artifacts) depends on T022. All these tasks are in Phase 4 but T021 is marked [P] despite depending on Phase 3 outputs. This violates the producer-consumer ordering principle.

T029 (cross-validation) is marked [US3] but depends on T022 (Beta/Ridge models) and T022-compare (Gaussian GLM) from Phase 4. T030 (R² variance) depends on T029. T031 (plots) depends on T029/T030. T032 (plot save) depends on T031. T033 (diagnostics) depends on T032. T029 is NOT marked [P], which is correct. However, T031 is marked [P] but depends on T029's model artifacts. T031 should not be [P].

T008a is marked [P] but the description says 'Define the heuristic... in src/config.py'. T008b says 'Use the heuristic defined in T008a'. Since T008a defines a constant in config.py and T008b reads it, they are technically independent in terms of file creation (config.py exists before T008b runs), but T008b's logic depends on T008a's value being present. This is a borderline case, but marking T008a as [P] is acceptable if config.py is created in T004. However, the dependency chain T008a->T008b->T008c->T008d->T008e is clearly sequential and should not have [P] tags on T008b-d.
